tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List every public VelaDeck strategy with its rebalance frequency, number of holdings and performance: 1-year and 5-year total return, annualized return and max drawdown (decimals: 0.12 = 12%). Use it to compare strategies.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Full public detail of one strategy by code (e.g. US20, IT15): description, rebalance frequency, holdings count, launch date, returns, drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino and benchmark when available. Does not include the holdings themselves.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Subscription plans and the Alpaca account balance range each one covers.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search VelaDeck blog articles about automated investing, AI equity strategies and Alpaca. Matches words in the title, excerpt and tags; an empty query returns the latest posts.
